name: GFX_hof_ic_tomsky_printers_union
title: 印刷工人工会
concept: Close-up tilted composing tray filled with rows of tiny lead type blocks, tops are abstract unreadable geometric relief marks, NO recognizable letters. ONE ink-stained hand arranging a block at tray edge. Behind are a lithographic roller and pale grey lithographic stone. Lower right one loose collective contract sheet with only ruled lines and two abstract dark signature blot shapes. Ink-black, lead-grey, paper-white. Work in progress, no bound books.

name: GFX_hof_ic_tomsky_moscow_trade_union_council
title: 莫斯科工会理事会
concept: Grey October city street with a compact procession of workers walking AWAY into distance, backs only, shoulder-to-shoulder in orderly files, carrying one tightly rolled dark-red cloth banner without text. Foreground ONE cuffed hand extends a small plain paper note toward procession. Low city buildings and heavy clouds, cold grey and dark brown, restrained dark-red cloth. No palace, battle, weapons or border map.

name: GFX_hof_ic_tomsky_central_council_of_trade_unions
title: 全苏工会中央理事会
concept: Symmetrical domestic workers union hall, converging rows of identical wooden chairs filled with dark worker BACK silhouettes in plain jackets. At bottom foreground edge a long wooden council table with plain documents and one cuffed hand resting upon them. At far wall one modest blank folded cloth banner, no text or symbols. High side windows cast warm white dusty beams. Wood-brown and charcoal, orderly national union assembly, no flags, globe, international spectacle or grand podium.

name: GFX_hof_ic_tomsky_platform_of_ten
title: 「十人纲领」
concept: Powerful row of five dark worker backs and shoulders standing shoulder-to-shoulder immediately in front of a tall cold-grey IRON GATE, blocking it. Heads seen only from behind, no facial detail. Gate has a small blank metal plaque. Feet on compacted earth. One narrow warm vertical light beam leaks from gate gap at RIGHT, backlighting silhouettes. Static resolve, charcoal-black silhouettes and cool iron grey, no weapons, cavalry, struggle or violence.

name: GFX_hof_ic_tomsky_the_silence_of_1921
title: 1921 年 5 月的沉默
concept: Quiet close-up of a vacant wooden lectern surface with ONE untouched neatly stacked set of pale speech manuscript sheets, only faint horizontal rules. At lower foreground a seated persons TWO anatomically correct hands folded together calmly in their lap, sleeves visible but no head or torso. CRUCIAL: a broad clearly visible empty dark gap separates withdrawn hands from the paper stack; hands do not touch or reach for paper. Background blurred empty hall chairs. Small vertical top-light isolates white paper, all surroundings cool dark grey with tiny faint warm highlights. No microphone, mouth, raised hand or gestures.

name: GFX_hof_ic_tomsky_man_from_tomsk
title: 来自托木斯克的人
concept: Full concluding composition about choosing a new name on a journey in 1906: wooden table foreground holds one white sheet with a SINGLE short abstract black ink-stroke shape suggesting an unreadable signature, absolutely no actual letters. ONE cuffed hand holds a short plain wooden writing pencil just lifted away after writing, tip above paper. At left an old travel satchel and a pair of worn boots. Behind an OPEN DOOR reveals a white snowy path receding to distant trees, daylight enters from outdoors. Warm-brown wood, paper-white, ink-black and cold snow-white. Hopeful onward journey, no prison, death, weapons or self-harm imagery, no date or numerals.
